UPDATE channelmembers
           SET roles = $3,
               lastviewedat = $4,
               msgcount = $5,
               mentioncount = $6,
               mentioncountroot = $7,
               urgentmentioncount = $8,
               msgcountroot = $9,
               notifyprops = $10,
               lastupdateat = $11,
               schemeguest = $12,
               schemeuser = $13,
               schemeadmin = $14,
               autotranslationdisabled = $15
         WHERE channelid = $1
           AND userid = $2
